name: Time For War
overview: Scripture reveals that there is an appointed time for war as part of God's sovereign order, acknowledging both the reality of conflict and the necessity of divine strength in battle. Believers are encouraged not to fear overwhelming enemies because the LORD, who delivered His people from Egypt, is with them. God equips His followers with skill and power to fight justly, emphasizing the responsibility to defend the vulnerable and oppose wickedness. While wars and rumors of wars will occur, as a sign of the times, God’s presence and purpose remain central to the believer’s confidence and endurance.
